metadata: Suket lies immediately south of Mandi and is separated from Simla Hill States by Satlaj.
Language of Suket is called Suketi; source says closely connected to Mandeali.
Bailey reports Pahar, Dhar and Bahal varieties; Grierson questions the division. Preserve attribution without making three new dialect records.
Source historical speaker total52184; not a current population.
pages.controls: Mandeali proper/Northern/ChhotaBanghali/MandealiPahari geographical descriptions are not Suketi lexical evidence.

pages.legend: Vocabulary of these two States; Chh.B,N,P mark items only in the named Mandeali variety; S marks items peculiar to Suketi.

attribution_decision: Do not discard79 unmarked group vocabulary lines. Preserve source-group scope and compare against explicit Suketi list/grammar before per-attestation language alignment. Legend does not establish exclusive Mandeali ownership, nor securely attest every unmarked item independently in Suketi. This requires typed source-scope accounting, not blanket inclusion/exclusion.
